verifiedScope.proxy: Lifetime original-French novel first-publication span from the original Hetzel book of Cinq semaines en ballon to the opening installment of L’Invasion de la mer; it is a publishing proxy, not a complete bibliography or claim of uninterrupted work.

verifiedScope.dateDistinctions: Markers use the earliest original-French publication: a first book edition where the novel appeared directly in volume, or the first serial year otherwise. They do not use composition, serial completion, later volume or English-translation dates; English titles are supplied for readability. Cinq semaines en ballon appeared directly as a book in January 1863. De la Terre à la Lune was serialized in September–October 1865 and issued as a book that October. Vingt mille lieues sous les mers, Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours, L’Île mystérieuse and Michel Strogoff have their periodical and volume dates distinguished in the entry note. L’Invasion de la mer began serialization during Verne’s lifetime on January 1, 1905 and was fully revised before his March 24 death, although the serial and volume were completed afterward. Paris au XXe siècle was written in 1860 but first published posthumously in 1994 and is excluded, as are plays, stories and nonfiction.
verifiedScope.influence: No claim of influence is inferred from chronological overlap.
